input.title: Unclear scope for site setup
input.message: The short text "Baustelleneinrichtung herstellen" and empty long text do not specify the required components, quantities or standards, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which demands a clear and exhaustive description.
input.suggestion: Add a detailed list of all required site facilities (e.g., temporary offices, storage, fencing, utilities) with quantities and reference to the applicable STLB standard.
